text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 41 syringes of pegfilgrastim at 2.8 per day (14.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 157 syringes combined at 5.7 per day (27.4 days on hand). FDA's records show pegfilgrastim is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): A label for pegfilgrastim names Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655) as the plant with operations including manufacture. FDA inspected that plant on 2024-06-14 and classified it VAI, with the classification known on 2024-08-16. The same plant received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-01-26, known on 2018-02-16.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately two to four weeks depending on site. No FDA shortage listing exists. The rule-based best option is to buy from Accord BioPharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord BioPharma, Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Biocon Biologics Inc., Coherus Oncology, Inc., Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc as backup sources; requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and inventory at both sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. P&T committee to review supply status at next scheduled meeting; requires committee chair approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications based on current supply.
